description: Rename a Highlight, change what goes in it or its refresh pace, or retire it (archived: true). Retiring it takes it off Stories that aren't filed yet.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name.description: As it shows under the circle; Instagram allows 15 characters

purpose.description: What belongs in it, e.g. "Customer reviews"

refresh_days.description: Flag it when no new Story has gone in for this many days

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: highlight_update
title: Edit a Highlight
